description: This file implements a lightweight HTTP client built on fetch, providing functions for making HTTP requests with features such as base URL handling, request ID generation, timeout management via AbortController, retries with exponential backoff for idempotent GET requests, and normalized error handling. It exposes a public interface with methods for typical HTTP verbs (get, post, put, patch, delete) as well as a generic request method.

methods.name: request(path, { method = 'GET', headers = {}, body, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, retries = MAX_RETRIES } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with normalized errors, handling request retries with exponential backoff for idempotent methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request with retries and backoff.

methods.name: doFetch(input, init, timeoutMs)
methods.description: Executes the fetch call with abort control and request ID assignment.

methods.name: parseJsonSafe(res)
methods.description: Safely parses response text as JSON, returning null on failure.

methods.name: handleResponse(method, { res, requestId })
methods.description: Processes the fetch response, normalizing errors and extracting data.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds the complete request URL based on a path and the base URL.

methods.name: sleep(ms)
methods.description: A helper function that returns a promise resolving after a specified delay.

methods.name: uuid()
methods.description: Generates a simple UUID-like string for request identification.

methods.name: isIdempotent(method)
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP method is idempotent.

methods.name: shouldRetry(method, status)
methods.description: Decides if a request should be retried based on method and response status.
